Name: Validate Food tab meal cards — Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner & Snacks are visible (sanity check)
Description: Sanity check: navigate to the Food tab and verify Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, and Snacks cards are visible.

Name: Validate profile dropdown — toggle button, avatar image, menu items and Sign Out link are visible (sanity check)
Description:
Sanity check: verify the profile dropdown toggle is visible, has correct aria attributes,
        contains an avatar image, and when opened shows expected menu items including Sign Out.

Name: Validate Health tab cards — Weight, Body Composition, Exercise, Blood Pressure, Blood Sugar & HbA1c are visible (sanity check)
Description: Sanity check: navigate to the Health tab and verify all key health metric cards are visible.

Name: Validate dashboard URL after successful login (sanity check)
Description: Sanity check: verify user is on the dashboard after sign in.

Name: Validate Learn tab (videos/documents) or Videos tab (Program Videos & Demo Videos) — conditional (sanity check)
Description:
Sanity check: detect whether the nav shows a Learn tab or Videos tab and validate accordingly.
        - Learn tab (/app/learn): at least one video card or document item must be visible.
        - Videos tab (/app/videos): 'Program Videos' and 'Demo Videos' section headings must be visible.

Name: Validate Meals, Weight and Exercise sections are visible on dashboard (sanity check)
Description: Sanity check: verify Meals, Weight, and Exercise cards are visible on the dashboard.

Name: Validate login page UI elements are visible and sign in (sanity check)
Description: Sanity check: verify the login page loads, all key UI elements are visible, then sign in.

Name: Validate Habits tab dropdown contains 'Active Habits' and 'Archived Habits' options (sanity check)
Description:
Sanity check: navigate to the Habits tab, open the filter dropdown,
        and assert both 'Active Habits' and 'Archived Habits' options are present.

Name: Validate dashboard header right icons are visible (sanity check)
Description:
Sanity check: verify the header right section contains smart-insights button (if available),
        discussion menu button, notification bell, and profile dropdown.

Name: Validate dashboard navigation header items are visible with correct labels and links (sanity check)
Description:
Sanity check: verify the top nav bar on the dashboard contains all expected items
        (Home, Food, Health, Learn, Habits) with correct hrefs.
